newsitem.title: MALTA: Mobile phones operator plans marketing drive.
newsitem.headline: Mobile phones operator plans marketing drive.

text.p: Maltese mobile phones operator Telecell Ltd said on Tuesday it was planning a marketing drive to coincide with the introduction of GSM mobile phones on the island in July.

The company, a subsidiary of Vodaphone Group Plc of Britain, said its penetration rate after seven years of business in Malta was some four percent of the population, with 16,000 people using mobile phones.
"We aim to have 40,000 clients by the year 2000, taking our penetration rate into double digits", company managing director Joe Grioli told a press conference.

He announced the introduction of GSM would be accompanied by cheaper off-peak calling rates. Call rates will also be calculated by the second, rather than in 30-second intervals, effectively cutting rates.
Telecell is the only mobile phones operator in Malta. State-owned telecommunications company Telemalta has a 20 percent stake.
